# IRONSTICK

> Complete offline-first legal case-management for Windows & Android with a built-in AI that knows your files: clients, cases, evidence, deadlines, e-mail, documents.

IRONSTICK is legal case-management software for Windows and Android that runs locally on the lawyer's computer. Every page of www.ironstick.legal is available below as Markdown; the HTML page named in each file is the original.

## English

- [The Case File That Works With You](https://www.ironstick.legal/index.md): Complete offline-first legal case-management for Windows & Android with a built-in AI that knows your files: clients, cases, evidence, deadlines, e-mail, documents.
- [Quick Start](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualquickstart.md): IRONSTICK quick start: install, licence, user and language, AI, signature, letterhead and client import.
- [User Manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualironstick.md): IRONSTICK user manual: every screen explained — what you see and what you can do.
- [Bridge Manual](https://www.ironstick.legal/manualbridge.md): IRONSTICK bridge manual: AI chat and bridge, the gates in the background, and eight workflows from day start to legal research.
- [The Case File That Works With You](https://www.ironstick.legal/kompendium.md): Complete offline-first legal case-management for Windows & Android with a built-in AI that knows your files: clients, cases, evidence, deadlines, e-mail, documents.
- [The Desktop-AI Bridge (Claude · ChatGPT · Qwen · Kimi)](https://www.ironstick.legal/bridge.md)
- [Screenshots](https://www.ironstick.legal/screenshots.md): See IRONSTICK in action — screenshots of the legal case-management system: login, cases, evidence, AI chat, documents and more.
- [Download & Licences](https://www.ironstick.legal/download.md): Download IRONSTICK: Client-App, Bridges, Server and Central Scan-App — with installation order, licensing rules and an order template. Licence keys on request, and a free one-month trial of the Client-App.
- [Pricing](https://www.ironstick.legal/pricing.md)
- [GDPR Data-Flow Declaration (External LLMs)](https://www.ironstick.legal/gdpr.md)
